change_summary: Put the canonical reader handoff beside the first material read and in the fetch result itself, so grounded answers reliably return one safe continuation link without expanding retrieval or link volume.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill returns only the current reader links needed to verify or continue an answer materially grounded by Corvio, without forcing writes or link dumps.

server_contract.note: The shared collaboration contract exposes the bounded read-grounded decision and complete MCP fetch results carry the exact canonical reader handoff beside the evidence.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.27 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.2.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI command surface remains compatible and receives the updated shared collaboration contract from the server.

help_center.note: The existing localized MCP Help already explains the bounded canonical reader-link rule introduced in 1.7.26.

package_setup.note: The existing package README already mirrors the bounded canonical-link rule; the compact Claude hook remains unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host Harness records returned, missing, or unavailable canonical reader handoffs without turning that observation into a false automatic semantic verdict.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover evidence-lane attribution, the bounded reader-link instruction, shared contract metadata and package version parity.
